canonical_name: Video-MME: The First-Ever Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark of Multi-modal LLMs in Video Analysis (Fu et al., CVPR 2025)
metric: accuracy on 4-option multiple-choice QA; two official settings: overall w/o subtitles and overall w/ subtitles (official leaderboard sorted by w/ subtitles)
ab_mode: single run averaged over 3 runs, w/ subtitles setting, no tools
ab_source: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3/blob/main/README.md (table row 'Video-MME (w. sub) | 90.0'; README first committed 2026-07-27; lab_reports date 2026-07-16)
c_source: https://github.com/MME-Benchmarks/Video-MME-v2 (README, launch 2026-04-07) and https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05015 (v1 2026-04-06; Chaoyou Fu et al., same first author/maintainer org MME-Benchmarks)
c_quote: README: 'In 2024, our Video-MME benchmark became a standard evaluation set for frontier models like Gemini and GPT. However, as model capabilities rapidly evolve, scores on existing benchmarks are saturating, yet a clear gap remains between leaderboard performance and actual user experience... To address this, we spent a year redesigning the evaluation system'; abstract: 'existing benchmarks are becoming increasingly saturated, exposing a critical discrepancy between inflated leaderboard scores and real-world model capabilities.'
score_at_release_system: Gemini 1.5 Pro (best model in paper/leaderboard; leaderboard entry dated 2024-06-15 after evaluation refresh)
lineage: Part of MME family (MME 2023-06, MME-RealWorld 2024-08). Successor by same team: Video-MME-v2 (arXiv 2604.05015, 2026-04; 800 videos, 3,200 QAs, grouped non-linear scoring).
best_by_cutoff: 90.4 (w/ subs) - Qwen3.8-Max, 2026-08-03, Qwen blog per lab_reports (qwen.ai blog is JS-rendered, not verified by me); verified: Kimi K3 90.0 (w. sub), 2026-07, Kimi-K3 README. Official leaderboard top is only 81.6 (video-SALMONN 2+, 2025-09-28).
notes: No human baseline in paper (checked arXiv HTML v3) -> criterion B. Lab self-reports on the w/ subs setting climbed 86.9 (Gemini 2.5 Pro, audio+visual+subs, 2025-06) -> 87.4 (Kimi K2.5, 2026-01) -> 87.5 (Qwen3.5, 2026-02) -> 87.8 (Qwen3.6-Plus, 2026-04) -> 88.0 (Qwen3.7-Plus, 2026-06) -> 90.0 (Kimi K3, 2026-07; exactly at threshold) -> 90.4 (Qwen3.8-Max, 2026-08). Kimi K3 README also reports Moonshot-run GPT-5.6 Sol 89.5 and GPT-5.5 89.3 (w. sub); Kimi K2.5 README (2026-01) lists Gemini 3 Pro 88.4* and GPT-5.2 86.0* (Moonshot-run), so no >=90 by 2026-01. No >=90 result found on the w/o-subs setting (best seen ~84.8 Gemini 2.5 Pro 'Overall'). GPT-5 86.7 is the long-video subset only. Strict: official leaderboard (maintainer-run) tops at 81.6 and lists no frontier models; no independent >=90 run found. C judgement call: the successor paper abstract names saturation of 'existing benchmarks' generically, but the README explicitly ties it to 'our Video-MME' -> coded C 2026-04 (same first author Chaoyou Fu and co-author Yunhang Shen, same MME-Benchmarks org). WebSearch unavailable; earlier >=90 reports by non-lab developers (e.g., ByteDance Seed) could not be searched.
